confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are medium confidence. Accommodation is lower confidence because July is peak beach season and rates vary widely by district and weekday. Cocktail and wine are anchored to the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search summary that reports the RBA homepage figure; I did not read that page directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Chinese coastal tourist cities with similar domestic price levels. No city-specific price sourcing was performed.
